verdict.rationale: cubic ships its own documented CLI that reviews local changes before you push, which covers the local-diff part of the story. Its documented output is a prompt for a coding agent, not structured data, and nothing shows it running non-interactively in CI. missing for 10: documented CI/script usage of the CLI, machine-readable output (e.g. JSON) for tooling, exit-code or flag reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I run reviews from a CLI against local diffs or in CI scripts, with machine-readable output my tooling can consume

citations.quote: The cubic CLI reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
